[G] DiagramService
|-- DiagramService is the sole content writer.
|   |-- create(input); getRevision(revisionId); listRevisions(diagramId)
|   `-- revise(baseRevisionId, edit); generate(request, options?)
|-- RevisionedDiagramService implements DiagramService
|   |-- Create and revise prepare edits through DiagramRevisionEditor.
|   |-- private issue(prepared, base?)
|   |   |-- diagramRevisions.register({ id, diagramId, parentId?, diagram, nodeRefs })
|   |   `-- Uses node correspondence to retain stable references where possible.
|   |-- An unchanged edit returns the existing revision.
|   `-- The imported registry's lifetime ownership is unspecified here.
`-- Generation uses an optional injected DiagramGenerator.
    |-- DiagramGenerationRequest: agentContext?, input, instruction, baseRevisionId?, context?
    |-- generator.generate(structuredClone(request), options)
    |-- Checks cancellation before and after generation and checks base identity.
    |-- A base revision selects revise; otherwise generation selects create.
    `-- GenerationOptions: signal?, onProgress?
